services.name: Whistler Explorer
services.desc: Choose a private helicopter for your group, or grab a seat for yourself Private Tour - $999 + 5% tax for up to 5 passengers in a private helicopter. Public Tour - $215 + 5% tax per seat. Set times only. (A minimum of 2 passengers are required to confirm a flight, we will match up guests as required). 15 minutes in the air About This spectacular aerial introduction to Whistler Blackcomb is an incredible way to discover your surroundings and take in the breath-taking beauty of the Whistler area. Peak to stunning Peak, remarkable views at every turn and no 14 minutes of flying • A stunning aerial introduction to Whistler!

services.name: Heli Golf - 19th Hole
services.desc: Heli Golf From Whistler Heliport - $1,489 + tax (up to 5 passengers) From Pemberton Airport - $1,265 + tax (up to 5 passengers) Details Take your game to new heights, 2,000 meters to be exact, with our exclusive heli-golf service. Whether you're looking to improve your skills or see the Pemberton Valley from above, it doesn't matter because you'll get to do both! What's included: Shuttle to Whistler Heliport from Whistler area golf courses (Fairmont, Nicklaus North, Whistler Golf Course) and select Whistler Village locations Scenic flight over backcountry mountains and glaciers to the Our mountaintop driving range (with eco-friendly balls)

services.desc: 25 minutes of flying • 20 minute alpine landing!

services.name: Silver Band Wedding
services.desc: Make your day truly memorable with an experience that will fuel dinnertime stories for years to come. Leaving the valley behind, you will take a scenic helicopter tour to Rainbow Glacier or Beverley Lake where you will be able to land for your ceremony. Enjoy the panoramic views and breathtaking scenery with a 45 Minute landing time. 12 minutes total flight time with a 45 minute alpine landing. Details: Maximum of 5 passengers is included. Children under the age of 2 fly for free on a parent's lap. It is your responsibility to book a marriage commissioner, 12 min flight • 45 min landing • Rainbow or Beverley

services.name: Gold Band Wedding
services.desc: Make your day truly memorable with an experience that will fuel dinnertime stories for years to come.
